newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian bonds end session firmer, eye on election.
newsitem.headline: Canadian bonds end session firmer, eye on election.

text.p: Canadian bonds closed stronger in a quiet session on Monday, helped by growing market expectations that the Liberals would be re-elected with a majority in today's election, analysts said.
"It's been more a lack of activity, but we're definitely closing on the bullish side," said one bond trader with a bank-owned brokerage. "(Traders) seem to be discounting the majority right now."
Canada's 30-year benchmark bond rose C$0.42 to C$112.52 to yield 6.996 percent.
